cases.documentContent: The project must deliver a reliable integration with explicit acceptance checks.

criteria.name: Reliable integration outcome
criteria.selectionReason: The source identifies integration reliability as the central project outcome.
criteria.successLink: Successful integration is required before the project can progress.
criteria.expectedBehaviorOrResult: The integration operates under the documented normal and failure conditions.
criteria.evaluationMethod: Review the agreed acceptance checks and source-supported integration results.

cases.documentContent: The project targets integration reliability, operational readiness, and a reusable decision record.

criteria.name: Integration reliability
criteria.selectionReason: Reliability is an explicit project objective.
criteria.successLink: The project succeeds only when the integration handles documented conditions.
criteria.expectedBehaviorOrResult: The integration passes the agreed normal and failure checks.
criteria.evaluationMethod: Review the acceptance checks and integration results.

criteria.name: Operational readiness
criteria.selectionReason: The source requires the result to be operable by the pilot team.
criteria.successLink: Operational readiness enables the intended pilot use.
criteria.expectedBehaviorOrResult: Documented operation and recovery checks are demonstrated.
criteria.evaluationMethod: Review operation and recovery evidence against the stated plan.

criteria.name: Reusable decision record
criteria.selectionReason: The source requires durable rationale for future continuation.
criteria.successLink: The project should leave a traceable basis for later decisions.
criteria.expectedBehaviorOrResult: Major choices and rejected alternatives are source-linked and reproducible.
criteria.evaluationMethod: Review the decision record for supported rationale and reproducibility.

cases.documentContent: مسار عمل اصطناعي يهدف إلى موثوقية التكامل وقابلية إعادة الاختبار، ولا يتضمن نصًا من معايير تقييم الموظفين.

criteria.name: موثوقية التكامل
criteria.selectionReason: تحدد الوثيقة موثوقية الربط كنتيجة أساسية لمسار العمل.
criteria.successLink: نجاح المسار يتطلب عمل الربط ضمن الحالات الموثقة.
criteria.expectedBehaviorOrResult: ينجح الربط في الحالات العادية وحالات الفشل المتفق عليها.
criteria.evaluationMethod: تُراجع نتائج اختبارات التكامل المرتبطة بالمصدر.

criteria.name: قابلية إعادة الاختبار
criteria.selectionReason: تشترط الوثيقة إمكانية إعادة التحقق من النتيجة.
criteria.expectedBehaviorOrResult: يمكن لمساهم آخر إعادة الاختبارات بنفس الشروط.
criteria.evaluationMethod: تُراجع خطوات التشغيل والنتائج المعاد إنتاجها.

cases.documentContent: المسار packages/ai-routing/src/router.ts يجب أن يحافظ على route trace وschema validation وfailure isolation.

criteria.name: Route trace preservation
criteria.selectionReason: The source requires every routed result to retain its trace.
criteria.expectedBehaviorOrResult: Each result retains the exact route and schema references.
criteria.evaluationMethod: Inspect the deterministic trace contract and persisted references.

criteria.name: Schema validation
criteria.selectionReason: The source requires strict structured output.
criteria.successLink: Validated output is necessary before domain persistence.
criteria.expectedBehaviorOrResult: Invalid structured output is rejected without partial persistence.
criteria.evaluationMethod: Review valid and invalid schema cases.

criteria.name: Failure isolation
criteria.selectionReason: The source identifies safe failure handling as a workstream outcome.
criteria.successLink: Isolation prevents a provider failure from corrupting domain state.
criteria.expectedBehaviorOrResult: Failure leaves no partial validated result.
